root_cause: Host firewall rules update (change CHG-4490) applied at 14:00 denies egress to reference-db:5432 for order-gateway, causing connection refused errors and high error rate with orders rejected HTTP 503.
summary: Escalated to on-call: The cause of the incident is due to a firewall rule update denying connectivity from order-gateway to reference-db, causing HTTP 503 errors. The proposed rollback is not safe to attempt currently as the link is down, so escalation is needed for further support.
